colors.notes: Red #b91c1c ONLY for pain stats/errors. Dark surfaces #0d1522 get radial blue glows: rgba(47,125,246,.14-.18) and rgba(18,63,158,.24-.30). Light-accent chips on dark use rgba(91,155,247,.4-.5) borders.

typography.family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif (self-hosted variable woff2, ital+wght 200-800, font-display swap)
typography.kicker: 12.5px, weight 800, letter-spacing .14em, uppercase, color deep_blue (light bg) or light_accent (dark bg)
typography.smoothing: -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-wrap balance on headings, pretty on long paragraphs

buttons.primary_on_dark: bg #2f7df6 → hover #5596f7, white text, weight 800, 15-16px, padding 15px 28px, pill

components.inputs: bg #f7f9fc, 1.5px border #e3e7ee → focus #2f7df6 + white bg, 12px radius, 13px 15px padding, 15px text; labels 11px 800 uppercase muted; errors #b91c1c 12.5px
components.chips: tint bg #e4edfd + #123f9e text (light) or rgba(13,21,34,.88) bg + 1px rgba(91,155,247,.4) border + white text (dark)
components.language_toggle: pill group, active segment #0d1522 bg + white text, inactive transparent + #3c4654

motion.floats: mbFloatA/B 5.5-7s ease-in-out alternate on hero cards/sprites
motion.reduced_motion: all of the above disabled; 3D scenes static

components.logo_usage: mobeeli-logo-blue.png on light surfaces; mobeeli-logo-white.png on dark surfaces (official dark-bg variant — replaces the design's CSS invert); mobeeli-mark.png for favicon/compact uses
